state_identities.run_identity: s1-04-${PBS_JOBID}; byte-identical to manifest run_identity.identity and every role/summary record
state_identities.derivation: canonical SHA-256 over the frozen deterministic fragment descriptors and per-fragment parameter/outer-state checksums; role startup recomputes and rejects mismatch

authoritative_observation.startup_interval: one complete GlobalStateStore.load_snapshot call over the frozen four-fragment descriptor set
authoritative_observation.startup_io_counter: CountingStorageBackend read invocations at the global-state API boundary
authoritative_observation.partial_bootstrap: snapshot load before every frozen current slot exists must raise and return no version vector
authoritative_observation.idempotence: identical repeated bootstrap creates zero new referenced or immutable payloads and preserves all content identities
authoritative_observation.conflict: same run/map/config/model identities with different initial fragment content must reject before changing any current record
authoritative_observation.identity_binding: writer reader analyzer and manifest builder must agree on the frozen config synthetic-model and synthetic-fragment-map identities reported in every role result and the summary
authoritative_observation.bounded_authority: current_records == referenced_payloads == fragment_count and total embedded base entries <= fragment_count * (S_max + 1)
authoritative_observation.version_rule: bootstrap version is zero and successor version plus outer_update_count are derived as previous plus one

formal_package: S1-00 builder/finalizer/validator with clean code/config/source/skill/scheduler/role/path identity and fail-if-exists root
failure_ladder: preserve the first L2 package; reproduce on one compute node with the same commit and deterministic four-fragment workload before any resubmission
